proposals.before: On renchen, Director of Southern Suburbs Rites and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Yan presented the names of the ascent songs, libation offerings, and dances for the Imperial Ancestral Temple: for the chamber of the Honored Ancestor, the 《Dance of Manifest Virtue》; for the Offered Ancestor, the 《Dance of Civilizing Brilliance》; for the Grand Ancestor, the 《Dance of Responding to Heaven》; for Zhaozong, the 《Dance of Eternal Peace》.
proposals.after: On renyin, Director of Southern Suburbs Rites and Grand Master of Ceremonies Li Yan presented the names of the ascent songs, libation offerings, and dances for the Imperial Ancestral Temple: for the chamber of the Honored Ancestor, the 《Dance of Manifest Virtue》; for the Offered Ancestor, the 《Dance of Civilizing Brilliance》; for the Grand Ancestor, the 《Dance of Responding to Heaven》; for Zhaozong, the 《Dance of Eternal Peace》.
proposals.reason: ZH has 壬寅 (renyin), not renchen; 太常卿 is Grand Master of Ceremonies, not Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

proposals.before: On guimao Dou Luge and the officials asked for an empress.
proposals.after: On guiwei Dou Luge and the officials asked for an empress.
proposals.reason: ZH date is 癸未 (guiwei), not guimao.

proposals.before: On guimao chief minister Dou Luge led the hundred officials in a memorial asking that the inner palace be established.
proposals.after: On guiwei chief minister Dou Luge led the hundred officials in a memorial asking that the inner palace be established.
proposals.reason: ZH date is 癸未 (guiwei), not guimao.

proposals.before: On dingsi the Secretariat memorialized, "The Yizong tomb is to be named Yongxing, the Xianzong tomb Changning, and the Taizu tomb Jianji."
proposals.after: On dingsi the Secretariat memorialized, "The Honored Ancestor tomb is to be named Yongxing, the Offered Ancestor tomb Changning, and the Grand Ancestor tomb Jianji."
proposals.reason: 懿祖/獻祖 are the chapter's Honored/Offered Ancestors, not Tang Yizong/Xianzong.

proposals.before: On dingsi, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "The Yizong tomb is to be named Yongxing, the Xianzong tomb Changning, and the Taizu tomb Jianji.」
proposals.after: On dingsi, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "The Honored Ancestor tomb is to be named Yongxing, the Offered Ancestor tomb Changning, and the Grand Ancestor tomb Jianji.」
proposals.reason: Same temple-name mistranslation as in the idiomatic field.

proposals.before: On bingchen Yang Li, a Luzhou junior officer, rebelled and held the city; Li Siyuan was made pacification commissioner with Li Shaozhen of Shaan as deputy to march against him.
proposals.after: On bingshen Yang Li, a Luzhou junior officer, rebelled and held the city; Li Siyuan was made pacification commissioner with Li Shaozhen of Shanzhou as deputy to march against him.
proposals.reason: ZH date is 丙申 (bingshen), not bingchen; 陝州 is Shanzhou.

proposals.before: On bingchen, Luzhou junior officer Yang Li seized the city in rebellion; Li Siyuan was made pacification commissioner, Shaanzhou acting commissioner Li Shaozhen deputy, and they led troops to attack him.
proposals.after: On bingshen, Luzhou junior officer Yang Li seized the city in rebellion; Li Siyuan was made pacification commissioner, Shanzhou acting commissioner Li Shaozhen deputy, and they led troops to attack him.
proposals.reason: ZH date is 丙申 (bingshen), not bingchen.

proposals.before: Li Shu became Director of the Imperial Clan; Yang Di became Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
proposals.after: Li Shu became Director of the Imperial Clan; Yang Di became Grand Servant (Minister of the Imperial Stud).
proposals.reason: ZH 太僕卿 is Taipu / Imperial Stud, not Grand Master of Splendid Happiness (光祿).

decisions.reason: s0002 opens 壬寅 and titles Li Yan 太常卿; renchen and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness (光祿卿) are wrong, and the proposed renyin plus Grand Master of Ceremonies match the Chinese.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 壬寅，南郊禮儀使、太常卿李燕

decisions.reason: s0087 dates the memorial 癸未 (guiwei), not 癸卯 (guimao); only the day name needs correction.
Same literal-field error: the Chinese day is 癸未, so guiwei is required and the rest of the sentence is already accurate.
s0140 names 懿祖、獻祖、太祖—the Later Tang Honored, Offered, and Grand Ancestors already used in this chapter—not Tang Yizong or Xianzong; the proposed temple-name English restores that identity.

decisions.reason: The literal field repeats the same 懿祖/獻祖/太祖 mistranslation as Yizong/Xianzong; replacing them with Honored/Offered/Grand Ancestor matches the Chinese and chapter usage.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 懿祖陵請以永興為名，獻祖陵請以長寧為名，太祖陵請以建極為名

decisions.reason: s0171 has 丙申 and 陝州; bingchen misreads the day, and bare "Shaan" drops 州, so bingshen and Shanzhou are warranted.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 丙申，潞州小校楊立據城叛，以李嗣源為招討使，陝州留後李紹真為副

decisions.after: On bingshen, Luzhou junior officer Yang Li seized the city in rebellion; Li Siyuan was made pacification commissioner, Shaanzhou acting commissioner Li Shaozhen deputy, and they led troops to attack him.
decisions.reason: 丙申 requires bingshen, not bingchen, but Shaanzhou already renders 陝州 accurately; changing it to Shanzhou is only stylistic, so keep Shaanzhou and fix the day alone.

decisions.after: Li Shu became Director of the Imperial Clan; Yang Di became Minister of the Imperial Stud.
decisions.reason: 楊遘’s new office is 太僕卿, not 光祿卿 (Grand Master of Splendid Happiness); the title fix is needed, but "Grand Servant (...)" is awkward—use Minister of the Imperial Stud, already used for 太僕卿 in this unit’s literal wording.
